hero.lead: We focus on a small number of markets we know well: Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC, Uzbekistan and Central Asia — connected to capital, technology and partners in Europe and beyond.

gcc.label: Why the GCC
gcc.title:
The GCC is not just a market.
It is a platform for growth.
gcc.lead: Economic diversification programmes, sustained infrastructure investment and fast technology adoption are reshaping the region — with Saudi Arabia at the centre. For investors and operators, that creates openings across sectors that barely existed a decade ago.
